entry_state: The six protocols distinguish extraction, reconstruction, forecasts, sector models, numerical inference and usability. Promotion requires the declared target, comparison and uncertainty evidence; failed candidates trigger scoped repairs. The implementation stages preserve banking and insurance requirements from the initial types while deferring their engines. Concrete corpus and release requirements continue next.
exit_state: Chapter 14 separates engineering, accounting, forecasting and human acceptance. Corpus acquisition is not independent validation, and provisional workload limits preserve partial coverage. Appendix A now supplies the portable operation signatures needed to implement the preceding semantics.
findings: The 192 report slots and 244 retained versions describe acquisition scope; they do not establish complete filing packages or representative sampling.
Publication metadata, exact-byte availability and independent annotation remain separate requirements.
The configurable workload limits define bounded failure behavior, not measured capacity or scientific defaults.
Engineering, accounting, forecast and human acceptance retain different required evidence. No new confirmed manuscript defect.
